content:
noa: Heads-up: onboarding CI started failing after the latest typegen regen. auth-flaky tests in sample-app are failing.
leo: Which CI?
noa: job #4588. Failure: 
```
FAIL tests/auth-flaky.test.ts
  Expected retry count 3, got 1
  at tests/auth-flaky.test.ts:33:9
```
hana: Any regendiff?
regen-bot: publish-checker: regen mismatch detected for 'ts-sdk'. Files changed: generated/clients/auth.ts. Semver impact: possible minor (behavioral).
rob: Could be a default change in one SDK. Did go-sdk change recently?
leo: Yes, go-sdk PR #404 changed default backoff multiplier (exponential base) and landed last week. ts-sdk didn't mirror it.
noa: That explains parity break. The generated client picks up inferred defaults from examples; reordering in the regen removed example that exercised the retry wrapper so the generated factory omitted it.
hana: So root cause = non-deterministic example ordering in typegen + coupling between examples and default behavior.
rob: Short-term options: revert the go change, update ts-sdk to match, or patch sample-app to pass retryPolicy explicitly. Fastest is patch sample-app to be explicit so onboarding CI stays green.
leo: I'll open a tiny PR to set retryPolicy in the sample-app examples.
noa: Meanwhile we should make codegen deterministic. I'll add a stable sort for example blocks and a regen hash test.
hana: Also we need to treat the SDK alignment as a minor semver bump; publishing will block if there's no changelog.
rob: Who will handle the changelog and release?
leo: I can draft the changelog and cut a ts-sdk minor release once regen stabilizes. Suggested note: "Align TypeScript SDK default auth retry/backoff with Go SDK to restore parity and prevent onboarding flakiness."
noa: PRs: sample-app hotfix https://github.com/redwood/sample-apps/pull/520, codegen deterministic sort https://github.com/redwood/codegen/pull/822. Triggering regen on codegen branch.
regen-bot: CI: regen-and-publish job started for thread 1777777777.
leo: Local regen on the codegen branch produced stable hashes. Pushing a sample-app test tweak to assert on outcome rather than exact retry attempts to reduce brittleness.
hana: Once codegen PR merges and regen hashes match, publish-checker should stop blocking. Then draft release notes and bump ts-sdk to a minor.
noa: CI rerun started for job 4588.
regen-bot: publish-checker: regen-diff resolved. No blocking regendiffs detected.
rob: Proceeding with ts-sdk@0.14.1 (minor bump) release. Changelog entry added and linked to PRs.
leo: Published ts-sdk@0.14.1. Upgraded sample-app to use it; onboarding e2e is green.
hana: Follow-ups: add a unit test in regen pipeline to fail on nondeterministic ordering and add a lint to prevent default inference based on examples unless explicitly annotated.
oa: I'll create a short devex note about semver for behavioral parity and encourage explicit defaults in sample code.ob: Thanks team. Closing thread and moving action items to the devex board. :tada:
